nodes.name: playwright.config.ts
nodes.summary: Configures Chromium end-to-end tests against a local Vite server, with CI retries and reporting, first-retry traces, and Supabase disabled to exercise HETU's local sandbox.

nodes.name: dashboard-analysis.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright smoke test that enters the local-first sandbox, verifies the dashboard analysis surface, checks the major study-loop routes, and validates essential mobile navigation controls.

nodes.name: enterLocalSandbox
nodes.summary: Navigates through local-sandbox authentication, conditionally dismisses onboarding, and waits for the dashboard's ordered actions and mistake-surface signals.

nodes.name: setup.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes Vitest's IndexedDB and DOM matchers, installs deterministic in-memory browser storage and matchMedia fallbacks, and supplies a ResizeObserver stub for chart-rendering tests in jsdom.

nodes.name: makeMemoryStorage
nodes.summary: Creates a Map-backed implementation of the browser Storage contract for deterministic localStorage and sessionStorage behavior in Node and jsdom tests.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Defines HETU's global Tailwind layers, daylight and dark design tokens, motion primitives, safe-area behavior, print rules, and reusable component styling for the responsive web and native-feeling study interface.
nodes.languageNotes: The CSS centralizes semantic RGB tokens for theme switching and combines Tailwind layers with custom animations, print behavior, and platform safe-area variables.
